Description: kernel time variables configuration utility This package provides a utility to manipulate the kernel time variables.  For a machine connected to the Internet, or equipped with a precision oscillator or radio clock, the best way to keep the system clock accurate is using NTP (Network Time Protocol).  However, for a standalone or intermittently connected machine, you may use adjtimex instead to at least correct for systematic drift.  It can optionally adjust the system clock using the CMOS clock as a reference, and can log times for long-term estimation of drift rates.
